thread:
alina: Heads-up — planning to wire the on-prem VPN into our PrivateLink endpoint for the analytics cluster. Quick Q: how should we manage the PSKs and PrivateLink credentials in Terraform? Thinking Secrets Manager + KMS, rotate PSKs regularly. PR with WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456

morgan: SGTM. Main thing is don’t put PSKs in TF state. Use a secret resource and reference via data source in modules. Also we need to confirm route propagation on the TGW side so traffic reaches the endpoint.

samir: Agree with Morgan. High level: Secrets Manager for PSKs/creds + KMS-backed CMK, rotation via Lambda or SecretsManager native rotation. In TF: create aws_secretsmanager_secret + aws_secretsmanager_secret_version and reference using data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version in modules. Example snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "onprem_psk" {
  name = "onprem/analytics/psk"
  kms_key_id = aws_kms_key.infra.arn
}
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "onprem_psk_version" {
  secret_id = aws_secretsmanager_secret.onprem_psk.id
  secret_string = jsonencode({ psk = var.initial_psk })
}
# consumers read via data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version
```
Note: keep `initial_psk` out of repo, use CI to generate one for first time.

kai: Few other checks: 1) PrivateLink endpoint service needs a consumer role if we require cross-account acceptance, make sure the role the on-prem gateway uses is allowed. 2) Endpoint policy should be strict — limit to the on-prem CIDR and required principals. 3) If BGP runs over VPN, store the BGP password in SecretsManager too.

alina: Good call. For rotation cadence — is 30d ok or should we do 14d for BGP PSKs? 30d seems fine for service creds but BGP psks maybe shorter.

samir: I’d recommend 14d for BGP PSKs if the automation is in place. Operationally we need: pre-rotation test, push to on-prem controller, and rollback on failure. We can implement a rotation lambda that: fetches new PSK, updates SecretsManager, calls on-prem API (or runs an automation job) to push the new PSK, then performs a health check.

morgan: Also remember to update TF variable docs and add a new `sensitive = true` var for the secret ARN usage. For PR, please include: 1) secrets resources, 2) kms key ref (reuse infra KMS), 3) IAM role/policy for rotation lambda, and 4) a tfstate exclusion note in README.

alina: Will update the PR with those items and add a short runbook for rotation. Tagging reviewers: @samir @kai. Any blockers for me to proceed?

kai: No blockers from networking side. Just ensure route table associations on the analytics VPC allow the endpoint traffic and you add a security group rule for the on-prem CIDR.

infra-bot: terraform-sandbox: plan succeeded with 0 changes (workspace: sandbox). No secrets were printed. :white_check_mark:

alina: Thanks all — I'll push the changes tomorrow morning and mark the PR WIP -> ready. If someone wants to pair on the rotation lambda, ping me. :thumbsup:
